options.text: To replace all intuitive design with a lengthy manual
options.misconception: misplaces the burden on documentation instead of design

options.text: To be as long and as detailed as possible at all times
options.misconception: confuses mere thoroughness with real usability

options.text: To appear only after a completely fatal system error

questions.stem: On Help and documentation: a designer reviewing a research institute's poster presentation notices that a complex tool offers no way for users to get guidance. What is the best role for help in a good interface?

options.text: To replace all intuitive design with a lengthy manual
options.misconception: misplaces the burden on documentation instead of design

options.text: To be as long and as detailed as possible at all times
options.misconception: confuses mere thoroughness with real usability

options.text: To appear only after a completely fatal system error
options.misconception: limits the useful role of help far too narrowly

options.text: To support the task with concise and searchable guidance

questions.explanation: Even well-designed tools benefit from concise, task-focused help. Good documentation is easy to search, stays focused on the user's goal, and supports the interface rather than compensating for a confusing one.
questions.hint: When should help be available and what should it actually contain?

options.text: It makes the button more precise by virtue of being so small
options.misconception: misreads the relationship between target size and speed

options.text: It increases the time and difficulty of reaching the target

options.misconception: denies a well-established and measurable relationship
